'''Hiwashi Shrine''' (日鷲神社) and '''Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine''' (天日鷲神社) are [[Shinto shrine]]s that enshrine the deity Ame-no-Hiwashi (天日鷲神, "Otori-sama") and belong to the Ōtori Faith tradition. There are 4 Hiwashi Shrines and 3 Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrines nationwide that are registered as religious corporations.

* [[Hiwashi Shrine (Minamisoma)|Hiwashi Shrine]] – Fukushima Prefecture, Minamisoma City, Odaka Ward, Onaba Aza, Meiji Chinza.
* [[Hiwashi Shrine (Tamura)]] – Fukushima Prefecture, Tamura City, Tokiha Town, Hotta Aza, Miyano-mae Chinza.
* [[Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (Tamura, Tsuro)]] – Fukushima Prefecture, Tamura City, Tsuro Town, Iwaizawa Aza, Hiranai Chinza.
* [[Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (Tamura, Tokiha)]] – Fukushima Prefecture, Tamura City, Tokiha Town, Yamane Aza, Kamakurayama Chinza.
* [[Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (Miharu)]] – Fukushima Prefecture, Tamura District, Miharu Town, Ōaza Tomizawa, Gobonki Chinza.
* [[Hiwashi Shrine (Mito)]] – Ibaraki Prefecture, Mito City, Kanaya Town, Chinza.
* [[Hiwashi Shrine (Oyama)]] – Tochigi Prefecture, Oyama City, Ōaza Kayabashi, Chinza.
